boundaryMeaning: Centre intersections describe geometric coverage only. UCDB and WUP are separate sources; their IDs and counts cannot be merged directly. Zero intersections do not exclude a candidate or imply a score.

boundaryPopulationCoverage.method: Native population cell centres inside 1000m-densified WUP2025 polygons; whole-cell values partitioned by the union of every positive-area intersecting old FUA. Covered and uncovered known cells conserve each centre total. No uniform density, raster reprojection or cross-centre population sum.
boundaryPopulationCoverage.limitations: Projected residential population, not census, citizenship, income or insured residents. Coarse whole-cell allocation and transformed boundary approximation affect small/coastal areas. Unknown population is counted as cells and excluded from the known-only share, not imputed zero. Geometry-review/outside-raster records remain unresolved. No commuting identity, whole-FUA resident coverage, cross-centre deduplicated global population, migration, scores, exclusion or global ranking eligibility follows.

knowledgeIdentitySources.scope: Frozen name-country source references, not cluster-FUA equivalence or scores

researchDirectorySignals.limitations: Each work ID counts once per qualifying directory FUA, with all eight ambiguity flags false for the qualifying author. A record can associate with multiple FUAs; candidate counts cannot be summed as unique global works or contribution. All types, corpus and retraction flags including null remain separate. Zero is no qualifying directory association, not no research. Directory location is not actual research site; no intellectual-version deduplication, research quality, resident diffusion, TEC score or exclusion bound.

legalMobility.meaning: Reviewed destination-specific legal conditions under the local citizenship assumption: EU/EEA/Swiss conditional residence rights, section 41 procedural onshore applications and Chinese and Indonesian citizens qualifying skilled-work national-visa routes are distinct. An application route is not approved residence or work. Unknown is not denial; residence does not establish citizenship. No affordability, job access, crisis operation, whole OPT score or exclusion bound established.

preliminary2026Violence.releaseAssumption: Fixed monthly versions, stated extraction schedule and pre-cutoff HTTP Last-Modified support inferred pre-cutoff availability; no independent historical archive obtained. Modification time is not verified publication time. This assumption is withdrawable; no case score or exclusion uses this intake.
preliminary2026Violence.meaning: Clear and pending current-window coded points retained separately; preliminary source and temporal-review limits remain. Zero is a table count, not zero violence or low risk. Existing GSS states and judgments unchanged; no score or exclusion uses this intake.

local2026Screening.meaning: Whole-scope exclusion screening of assembled evidence, not full city evaluation. Partial sources and conditional calibration scores establish no whole-dimension exclusion bound or qualified 32nd-place threshold. All candidates remain possible competitors; no exclusions or ranking eligibility granted.

notAssembledMeaning: Existing sources may contain relevant fields, but no qualified whole-candidate measurement has been assembled here.
historicalMeaning: Historical city research references are not global-protocol scores; union members do not inherit duplicated scores.

PCS: geophysical: reference-rock seismic hazard only, not building losses
RES: water: country urban service context only, not city reliability
GSS: organized_violence: partial historical events plus separate preliminary January-August 2026 coded-point review; source release assumption, temporal conflicts, pending statuses and unassigned records retained, not complete impacts or GSS scores
LON: translation: 2024 published single-drug Medicare FFS claims associated with next-year-end provider registered addresses; exact Census range points are not treatment sites or patient residences; missing, uncertain and outside-payer states retained, no resident access, quality or whole-dimension score
TEC: digital_infrastructure: self-selected 2026 Q3 network tests only; boundary sensitivity retained, not population access or complete technology capability

knowledge_output: 2025 work-ID presence associated with qualifying frozen institution directory FUAs; types, corpus and retraction flags retained separately; not verified research sites, deduplicated intellectual works, contributions, quality or resident diffusion; zero associations do not imply zero research
OPT: transport_redundancy: directory airport points and scheduled nonclosed flags only; no resident access, routes, independent alternatives or common failures measured

legal_mobility: reviewed Germany/France conditions under modelled citizenship only; conditional residence rights differ from section 41 onshore applications and Chinese and Indonesian citizens qualifying skilled-work national-visa routes; conditional paths are not approved residence or work; no actual affordability, employment or crisis operation measured

sourceJoinKey: efua_id; source tables and their provenance remain authoritative for values and limitations
